text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Finance House to establish a 15 to 20 million dinar portfolio for real estate.
- Finance minister says unifying custom fees between Arab Gulf states is difficult but possible.
- The foreign ministers of Kuwait and Jordan discuss resumption of bilateral ties frozen since Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
- Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development signs six million dinar loan to help Lebanon construct a coastal high-way.
- Central Bank governor says a number of local banks conduct serious merger talks.
- Kuwait Univarsity professor and writer Ahmed al-Baghdadi, known for his harsh criticism of Islamic organizations in Kuwait and abroad, receives death threat.
